verdict.rationale: Shopify's APIs (Admin, Storefront) are GraphQL-based, and while docs describe schemas, versioning, and a GraphiQL explorer, there is no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec — a direct probe of common spec endpoints (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 across all candidates. No vendor claim exists for an OpenAPI-equivalent machine-readable spec download, so this is an unmet capability rather than a disputed claim.
